# StudyBites agent instructions

- At the start of every session, read `PROJECT_BRIEF-1.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/ROADMAP.md`, `docs/PRODUCT_PLAN.md`, and `docs/STATUS.md`.
- Work on one roadmap item at a time.
- When a roadmap item is completed, update `docs/ROADMAP.md` and record the decision in `docs/DECISIONS.md`.
- End every task with the handoff report required by the working rules in `PROJECT_BRIEF-1.md`.
